collector.name: ČSÚ RES primary + OSM supplemental + Kurzy.cz reviewed leads + ARES verification
collector.kurzy_scope: small public manually reviewed sample, not a complete licensed daily export
collector.notes: No-website tag denotes a missing directory URL, not independently verified absence of a website. Scores are preliminary.

leads.name: ELEFANT - PRAHA, s.r.o.
leads.business_activity: Company site describes roofing and waterproofing work; published references; separate registry confirms registered business and operating premises

editorial_review.business_case: Published roofing and waterproofing references include dated projects from 2011; an easier-to-update project showcase and quotation path may be worth discussing. No broken pages, poor mobile UX, financial capacity or buyer interest have been verified.
editorial_review.evidence_scope: Public company website and published company registers only; no completed browser or financial audit
next_checks: Independently verify company website identity against ARES
Audit mobile navigation, quotation flow and recent portfolio
Ask whether website updates are a commercial priority
Confirm company contact and ability to fund a project

leads.reason: Prague roofing and waterproofing contractor with public work references. Potential case-study and quote-request website modernization to investigate; not a verified design defect.
leads.score_reason: Editorial research idea based on website service/reference pages and dated register evidence. Scoring and ARES website checks pending.
leads.offer: Modern roofing portfolio with sortable reference projects, service pages and quote-request CTA
leads.outreach_angle: Ask whether the references represent current services and whether a project-based enquiry website would add value. Do not claim the current site is broken.

leads.name: KOLOS Praha s.r.o.
leads.business_activity: Company website lists Prague construction/renovation services and Prague contact office; public registry indicates operating premises

editorial_review.business_case: Published Prague renovation references and older news entries from 2012–2013 suggest a possible discussion about keeping completed projects current through a CMS and making quotation requests more effective. No technical fault, lost enquiries or actual budget is verified.
editorial_review.evidence_scope: Source-linked website and registry review; Prague trading-address listing should be reconfirmed before outreach
next_checks: ARES company status, Praha operating address and site identity
Inspect current navigation and mobile quote-request experience
Check recency of real project references and content update needs
Verify buyer need, contact and financial capacity

leads.reason: Prague-area contractor advertising reconstruction and construction projects; potential portfolio/CMS and request-a-quote upgrade to investigate.
leads.score_reason: Editorial sales-fit idea, not verified poor website or confirmed buyer budget.
leads.offer: Case-study-driven construction website with fresh references, service pages and quote form
leads.outreach_angle: Ask if project references are current and whether improving the online enquiry flow would be useful; do not claim broken site.

leads.name: An Beauty Studio
leads.reason: The Prague salon offers manicures, pedicures, haircuts and eyebrow styling, while its public directory profile directs visitors to Instagram rather than a dedicated site. A service and booking website could help visitors compare treatments and enquire.
leads.score_reason: Documented 2025 business registration, Prague salon address, public phone/email and active salon listings. Independent domain search, booking UX audit, budget and decision-maker permission are not yet verified.
buying_signals: Instagram shown as website in business directory
verification_gaps: Confirm no separate independent website or booking destination exists
Confirm salon is actively taking new clients and contact reaches decision-maker
leads.offer: Booking-first beauty website with clear service menu, prices, gallery and mobile enquiry
leads.outreach_angle: Show a compact mobile service-and-booking demo based on public business facts; verify the current booking process first.

leads.name: Marina Hreben
leads.reason: A small independent beauty operator with a registered Kobylisy service location from March 2026 and public business listings directing visitors to Instagram. A premium service, portfolio and booking website is a plausible growth opportunity.
leads.score_reason: Prague operating address, salon phone/email and March 2026 premises registration are public. Opening of the registered premises does not prove the first customer opening day. Independently searching for a website and checking the booking flow remain outstanding.
buying_signals: Premises register lists Kobylisy location effective 2 Mar 2026 (not confirmed first opening)
verification_gaps: Independently check for a standalone business website and existing booking funnel
Confirm bookings/activity and whether this contact is the purchasing decision maker
Check visual portfolio rights before a demo
leads.offer: Premium beauty portfolio with services, before/after gallery, pricing and booking CTA
leads.outreach_angle: Present a sample brows/lashes service page and booking experience, but first verify existing website and booking tools.

leads.name: Café Marathon
leads.reason: A café with a business registered in September 2025, listed operating hours and reviews from 2026. Its current directory listing points to Instagram instead of a standalone website; a menu/location and events page is a testable sales angle.
leads.score_reason: 2025 registration, Prague trading address, current listing and social contact are publicly documented. No independent domain search or full audit; buyer and budget are unconfirmed.
buying_signals: Instagram supplied as public web destination
verification_gaps: Find verified direct business email or phone, or confirm Instagram accepts enquiries
Check independent website and any existing menu/booking tools
Validate opening date and decision-maker interest
leads.offer: Editorial café website with menu, hours, maps, events and mobile-first directions
leads.outreach_angle: Offer a visual mobile prototype for menus, opening hours and visits; avoid claiming no website without checking.
